description: A polygon is described by one or more linear rings: an exterior ring optionally followed by interior rings. It serializes to a type discriminator and a nested array of coordinate arrays, and round-trips back to an equal value, including the multi-ring (exterior plus interior) case. Construction validates its input: a null ring sequence is rejected as a missing required argument, and any ring that is not a closed linear ring (at least four coordinates, first equal to last) is rejected as invalid. Polygons built from equal rings compare equal and share a hash code.
